jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARCHY

Smile! Those teeth you are showing deserve the best care you can give them, yet the status quo of the software your dentist uses today is outdated.

Archy is a Series C vertical SaaS solution revolutionizing the dental practice management space — giving dental providers AI agents and software that lets them do what they do best (be dentists!) while we handle the more technical sides of running their practice business.




JOB DESCRIPTION

Archy is adding our first Customer Success Managers to the Customer Experience team. As a Customer Success Manager, you'll ensure each practice gets real, measurable value from Archy. You'll drive product adoption, strengthen customer relationships, identify growth opportunities, and proactively reduce churn.

This is a digital-first, scaled role: you'll lead with efficient, one-to-many programs, leverage automation, and lean on data to decide where higher-touch, one-to-one attention is worth it. And because you're one of our first CSMs, you won't just run the playbook — you'll help write it.




JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate with other CSMs to drive adoption, retention, and growth across our growing portfolio of customers. 

 - Drive product adoption primarily through efficient digital, one-to-many motions — in-app guidance, webinars, office hours, and targeted campaigns — while layering in higher-touch outreach for your most strategic accounts.

 - Use product usage data to identify underutilization and proactively guide practices in adopting the features that deliver the most value.

 - Grow expansion revenue by acting on customer health and business signals — usage trends, sentiment scores, and practice performance such as appointments closed per month and total revenue production — through both inbound and outbound plays.

 - Identify churn risk early from explicit signals (cancellation intent, complaints, escalations) and implicit ones (declining logins, usage, or sentiment), and run proactive outreach before accounts reach the edge.

 - Own reactive save motions when a practice raises a concern, turning difficult conversations into healthier, more enduring relationships.

 - Carry accountability for gross and net revenue retention for your book, managing renewals and accurately forecasting risk.

 - Live in customer health and usage dashboards to segment your book and prioritize your day around the highest-impact accounts and signals.

 - Expected to actively adopt and integrate AI tools into day-to-day workflows to enhance productivity, decision-making, and overall impact.

 - Partner closely with Onboarding on hand-offs, Support on escalations, and the Sales and CX leadership teams on growth and at-risk accounts.

 - Act as the voice of the customer, feeding themes back to Product to improve the platform and the broader customer journey.

 - As one of our first CSMs, contribute to the playbooks, health-scoring models, and outreach cadences that will scale the Customer Experience team as we grow.




JOB REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience in the healthcare industry (dental industry preferred).

 - Experience engaging with high-level practice owners and an understanding of the intricacies of running a dental practice

 - Experience in customer success, account management, or a customer-facing sales role, ideally at a SaaS company, with a track record of retaining and growing a book of business.

 - Comfort owning a high-volume, digitally-led book of accounts rather than a small set of enterprise relationships.

 - A commercial, outcomes-driven mindset — motivated by adoption, retention, and expansion targets, and confident hitting them.

 - Strong data fluency: able to read usage and health data, draw conclusions, and decide where to spend your time.

 - Exceptional communication skills, comfortable running one-to-many programs and handling sensitive one-to-one conversations with equal skill.

 - Leverages AI tools and automation in everyday work to move faster, improve outcomes, and continuously raise the bar on how we operate.

 - Demonstrated business acumen with the ability to understand customer needs, articulate value, and influence stakeholders.

 - Confidence in navigating ambiguity and self-direction in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.

 - High technical aptitude — you pick up new software quickly and can guide customers through it credibly.

 - Strong sense of accountability and exceptional personal organization.

 - Experience in the healthcare industry or another industry vertical, and engagement with SMB owners & operators, preferred (dental industry a strong plus).

 - Hands-on experience with a customer success platform (e.g., Gainsight, Vitally, Catalyst) or a CRM (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce), a plus.



What We Offer: 

 - Competitive salary and equity (some roles may be eligible for performance-based incentives or bonuses)

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) plan

 - Flexible vacation policy

 - Remote-friendly culture

jobs.title: Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
About Archy

Smile! Those teeth you are showing deserve the best care you can give them, yet the status quo of the software your dentist uses today is outdated.

Archy is a Series C vertical SaaS solution revolutionizing the dental practice management space — giving dental providers AI agents and software that lets them do what they do best (be dentists!) while we handle the more technical sides of running their practice business.



Job Description:

Dental practices choose a lot of their software and services on the advice of people they already trust, like the IT company that runs their network or the supply rep who stops by every month. Some of our best opportunities start with those relationships. We're hiring a Partnerships Manager to build them. You'll find the companies whose clients are dental practices, get in front of their owners and field teams, and turn them into a steady source of referrals for our account executives.

This is a hunting role. Every week you'll have first conversations with people who've never heard of Archy: owners of dental IT companies, reps at supply and aligner companies, startup advisors, and practice coaches. When time is short, signing new partners comes before looking after the ones we have. You won't close practices yourself. Every practice a partner sends goes to the account executive who owns that territory, and your job is to keep the partners sending them.

In your first month you'll learn to run the Archy demo yourself. By 90 days you'll have recruited 10 new partners who have each sent us a practice, we'll have held 30 demos with practices your partners sent, and our first field-rep referral pilot will be live. Partnerships take time to build, so six months is the real measure. By then partners should be sending us 25 demos a month, with at least 5 of those practices signing each month.

You don't need to know dentistry on day one. We'll teach you the product and the industry, and we'll expect you to fill your own calendar with first meetings.



Job Responsibilities:

 - Prospect new partners every day. Build target lists of net-new partners (dental IT companies that serve practices in several territories, supply and aligner companies, startup advisors, and coaches) and work them by phone, email, LinkedIn, and in person. A normal week is 15 to 20 partner meetings, at least 5 of them with people who've never heard of Archy.

 - Sign partners and get them to a first referral fast. Pitch our partner program, put agreements in place on our standard terms, and stay close to each new partner until the first practice comes through.

 - Own our startup advisor partners. Run our relationships with the advisors, installers, and lenders who help dentists open new practices, from the first meeting through co-hosted events and a steady flow of referrals.

 - Build field-rep referral programs. Work with supply and aligner companies so their reps introduce Archy on visits they're already making, and make it easy and worth their while.

 - Build our KOL program. Find the dentists, coaches, and industry voices other dentists listen to, bring them close to Archy, and get them in front of the right audiences at our events and our partners' events.

 - Throw events with our event marketer. Plan and host dinners, meetups, and partner nights with KOLs, influencers, and partners, working toward one a week.

 - Keep coaches and consultants close. Check in monthly or quarterly so Archy is the first name they give when a client asks about software, and teach them the product well enough to recommend it.

 - Report the numbers every week. Track every partner and referral in HubSpot and Referral Rock, and send a weekly scorecard of meetings, new partners, referred demos, and wins.

 - Represent Archy in the room. Work conference floors and present to partners' sales teams. Public speaking for Archy goes through leadership approval first.

Job Requirements:

 - 3+ years in a quota-carrying sales role, including at least a year recruiting new channel, referral, or reseller partners, ideally at a vertical or SMB software company.

 - A track record of opening relationships with people who didn't know you, with numbers you can share (meetings booked, partners signed, partner-sourced revenue). We'll ask.

 - You can hold a room, whether it's a partner's Monday sales meeting, a conference floor, or a product demo.

 - Good commercial judgment. You can put a deal together from a set menu of terms, and you know when to escalate.

 - You keep your CRM clean, because if it isn't logged, it didn't happen.

 - You use AI tools to research accounts, build lists, and draft outreach.

 - You're coachable and quick to change your approach based on feedback.

 - You can travel for conferences, partner visits, and events.

 - Experience selling to or through IT managed service providers is a plus.

 - Experience working with distributor or manufacturer field sales teams is a plus.

 - Experience running events or working with KOLs and influencers is a plus.

 - Experience running a referral or partner program in HubSpot, Referral Rock, PartnerStack, or similar is a plus.
   

What We Offer:

 - Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, plus Spring Health and One Medical access.

 - Competitive Compensation: Base pay and equity, 401(k) with company match, and performance-based incentives (bonus or commission eligibility by role).

 - Flexibility & Remote Support: Full remote-friendly culture, home office stipend, and flexible time off to rest and recharge (policies vary by role).

 - Team Connection: Annual all-company offsites to collaborate and connect in person.
